changelog: Tightened numeral/date ascendency rule and added an explicit exception to demote cuts that split a numeral from its unit (traceable to measured over-trust on NUM–unit splits).
Added a rule to demote cuts that separate short parenthetical/identifier tokens (e.g., titles, abbreviations) from surrounding punctuation because these were mis-scored as strong anchors.
Added a positive bias for cuts that precede sentence-initial pronouns 'it' and 'it's' to correct observed under-ranking.
Made tie-breaking explicit in the scoring tendencies (prefer earlier marker when surface cues tie) to implement the tie_fix.
Replaced one example (Officials in the capital...) with a new example showing a lifted score before 'it', and adjusted the 'researchers 1,200' example to show demotion of a NUM–unit split.
